# Claude Code Docs & Local Python Agent SDK

> LLM-friendly index of the Claude Code docs catalogue (code.claude.com/docs) plus the local Python Agent SDK skill bundle installed on this machine. The Claude Code docs page is the upstream source — this file mirrors it filtered to the Agent SDK sections and supplements with the local runnable scripts from `~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk`. Use this file to discover which docs page covers a topic before reading the live source.

## Agent SDK — Python

- [Agent SDK overview](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/overview.md): Build production AI agents with Claude Code as a library. Compare the Agent SDK to the CLI, Client SDK, and Managed Agents.
- [Quickstart](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/quickstart.md): Install the Python or TypeScript SDK, set your API key, and build your first agent.
- [Python SDK reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/python.md): Complete API reference for the Python Agent SDK — every function, type, and class.
- [TypeScript SDK reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/typescript.md): Parallel reference for the TypeScript Agent SDK.
- [Local Python SDK skill overview](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/SKILL.md): Decision tree for `query()` vs `ClaudeSDKClient`, installation, authentication, six core patterns.
- [Local Python SDK API reference](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/references/api_reference.md): Complete signatures for `query()`, `ClaudeSDKClient`, `Tool`, `ToolDefinition`, `ToolParameter`, hooks, MCP, auth, error patterns.
- [Local Python SDK best practices](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/references/best_practices.md): When to use `query()` vs `ClaudeSDKClient`, tool design, hook patterns, session security, performance, testing, common gotchas.

## Agent SDK — Core Concepts

- [How the agent loop works](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/agent-loop.md): Message lifecycle, tool execution, context window, and SDK architecture.
- [Use Claude Code features in the SDK](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/claude-code-features.md): Load project instructions, skills, hooks, and other Claude Code features into SDK agents.
- [Work with sessions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/sessions.md): How sessions persist agent history, and when to use continue, resume, and fork.
- [Persist sessions to external storage](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/session-storage.md): Mirror session transcripts to S3, Redis, or your own backend.
- [Streaming input](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/streaming-vs-single-mode.md): Two input modes and when to use each.
- [Stream responses in real time](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/streaming-output.md): Real-time text and tool-call streaming.
- [Handle approvals and user input](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/user-input.md): Surface Claude's approval requests and clarifying questions.
- [Structured output](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/structured-outputs.md): Return validated JSON via JSON Schema, Zod, or Pydantic.
- [Todo Lists](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/todo-tracking.md): Track and display todos from the SDK.

## Agent SDK — Tools, Hooks, MCP

- [Custom tools](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/custom-tools.md): Define in-process MCP tools so Claude can call your functions.
- [Local Python SDK: custom tool script](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/scripts/custom_tool.py): Runnable example — mortgage calculator + code validator + streaming tool.
- [Hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hooks.md): Intercept and customize agent behavior at key execution points.
- [Local Python SDK: hooks script](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/scripts/hooks_example.py): Runnable example — logging, policy enforcement, session lifecycle, rate limiting.
- [MCP integration](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/mcp.md): Configure MCP servers, transport types, tool search, authentication, error handling.
- [Local Python SDK: MCP script](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/scripts/mcp_integration.py): Runnable example — filesystem, GitHub, multiple servers, error handling.
- [Tool search](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/tool-search.md): Scale to thousands of tools by discovering and loading on demand.
- [Permissions](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/permissions.md): Permission modes, hooks, and declarative allow/deny rules.
- [Subagents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/subagents.md): Define and invoke subagents to isolate context and run parallel tasks.
- [File checkpointing](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/file-checkpointing.md): Track file changes and restore to any previous state.
- [Local Python SDK: file operations](file://~/.claude/skills/python-agent-sdk/scripts/file_operations.py): Runnable example — analyze_file, list_directory, search_in_files.

## Agent SDK — Advanced

- [Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/skills.md): Extend Claude with specialized capabilities via Agent Skills.
- [Slash Commands](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/slash-commands.md): Control Claude Code sessions through the SDK.
- [Plugins](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/plugins.md): Load plugins to extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers.
- [Modifying system prompts](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/modifying-system-prompts.md): `claude_code` preset vs custom prompt, CLAUDE.md, output styles.
- [Cost and usage tracking](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/cost-tracking.md): Track tokens, estimate costs, configure prompt caching.
- [OpenTelemetry observability](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/observability.md): Export traces, metrics, and events to your observability backend.
- [Hosting and secure deployment](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/hosting.md): Production deployment — subprocess architecture, scaling, multi-tenant isolation.
- [Securely deploying AI agents](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/secure-deployment.md): Isolation, credential management, network controls.
- [Migration guide](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk/migration-guide.md): Migrate the Claude Code SDKs to the Claude Agent SDK.

- [Agent harness design](https://claude.com/blog/a-harness-for-every-task-dynamic-workflows-in-claude-code): How Claude Code orchestrates subagents.

## Optional

- [Terminal config](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/terminal-config.md): Fix Shift+Enter, terminal bell, color theme, Vim mode.
- [Rules](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/rules.md): Project-specific rules loaded automatically.
- [Workflows](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows.md): Dynamic workflows referenced above.
- [Auto mode config](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-config.md): Configure the auto mode classifier.
- [Advisor tool](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/advisor.md): Pair main model with a stronger advisor.
- [Fast mode](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/fast-mode.md): Faster Opus responses.
- [Prompt library](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/prompt-library.md): Copy-paste prompts.
